title: Reoccurring Dream
content: Hey! I have had this reoccurring dream since i was little. For some reason, it takes place in a green and white barn. We always are hanging out in a stall filled with loose hay. But basically this guy (who I don't know, but he's blonde) and I get really close. He teaches me how to play an instrument (it's a different instrument each time I have this dream) and we fall in love. And its the most intense love ever. Filled with Passion. don't know who the guy is in my dream but he's aged with me as i've aged. It's almost identical each time, except for the instrument being different. I was reading about how dreams might be shared dreams. Has anyone else had a reoccurring dream like this? It's the same person every time. Once was a guitar, a keyboard, a violin, etc. The guitar was the most common one though.
